plugins.name: dev-mentor
plugins.description: Teaching companion for developers — guides with questions instead of answers, enforces PR quality before submission, and is ADHD-friendly by design.

skills.name: mentor
skills.description: Always-on teaching companion. Handles all development help: explaining code, fixing bugs, implementing features, debugging, guidance. Automatically runs the PR checklist before git push or PR creation. Activates when the user signals they're done or ready to submit. Also responds to /pr-guardian for a manual PR check.
headings: What This Skill Does NOT Do
skills.description_zh: 作为持续教学伙伴解释代码、修复缺陷、实现功能和调试，在用户准备提交时自动执行PR清单，也可通过/pr-guardian手动检查。

skills.name: pr-guardian
skills.description: Standalone PR/MR checklist enforcer. No mentor mode, no teaching — just a fast, direct checklist check. Activates when the user runs git push, gh pr create, glab mr create, signals they are done with a task, or invokes /pr-guardian directly. Does not require mentor to be active.
headings: Step 4 — Report and block if needed
skills.description_zh: 独立执行快速PR/MR清单检查，在git push、创建PR/MR、任务完成或/pr-guardian时触发，无需教学伙伴模式。

skills.name: wdyt
skills.description: Command — not a mode. Triggers when the user types /wdyt or asks 'what do you think?', 'does this look right?', 'is this correct?', 'check my changes', or 'review what I did'. Runs a quick sanity check on recent code changes. Available at any point in any session mode.
skills.description_zh: 在/wdyt或请求检查近期变更时，对代码修改进行快速合理性检查，作为命令可在任何会话模式使用。
